item.name: 04 - Website Content detail diagnostics (run separately)
item.description: Diagnostic requests for Website Content v2 detail/index routes. As verified on 8 September 2026, the integration gateway accepted the application key but its staging content origin returned an HTML 401 Access Denied response for these routes. Symptoms A in folder 01 still passed. Run this folder only when checking whether NHS has restored those upstream routes.

exec: pm.test("HTTP status is 200 when the NHS upstream route is healthy", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Response is JSON, not an upstream HTML error", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type") || "").to.include("json"); });

request.description: Diagnostic only. A current HTTP 401 HTML Access Denied page from nhswebsite-staging.nhs.uk indicates the known NHS upstream issue, not a missing Postman API key.
